limitations: Eligibility, goods, deadlines and operator fees must be checked for the actual purchase. No refund is guaranteed.

shared_notes.text: Check whether your U.S. health insurance pays for overseas treatment. Consider separate medical and evacuation cover, and check exclusions for pre-existing conditions and planned activities. Trip-cancellation cover alone may not cover medical treatment. Ask how hospitals are paid and how to reach emergency assistance.
